maria: Ran a randomized sweep (batch=1..12, seq=128/512/1024/2048) across A100/H100/L40S this morning. H100 shows a reproducible throughput oscillation when batch hits ~6-8 at seq 1024/2048. Selector keeps flipping between fused_paged_v2 and flash_attention_v3 and we get 15-30% p95 spikes. Anyone seen this pattern?

maria: ```
# quick numbers (throughput tokens/sec, H100, seq=2048)
batch 4 -> 12.3k (stable)
batch 6 -> 9.1k (oscillates every ~10-20s)
batch 8 -> 11.8k (oscillates)
profile hint: kernel_time jitter + occasional kernel_launch_syncs
selector: fused_paged_v2 <-> flash_attention_v3
```

tom: :eyes: do you have perf traces (nvprof/CUPTI) or a runtime trace showing the selector decision and memstats?

maria: pasted a tiny CUPTI slice and runtime log below. The runtime log shows a kernel choice message right before the p95 jump.

maria: ```
[runtime] choose_kernel model=7b seq=2048 batch=6 -> fused_paged_v2 (mem headroom borderline)
[cupti] kernel_ms: 8.9, 9.2, 27.8, 9.1, 8.8   # 27.8 = spike
[runtime] kv_cache_evictions=3, spill_count=1
```

perf-bot: Automated alert: p95 latency increased by 22% on h100-rtpool-3 between 09:12-09:18. Tagging owners.

kevin: My hunch: selector hysteresis is too aggressive around fused_paged_v2 heuristics. If fused_paged tries to fit but hits SM/shared memory boundary we might get a fallback path that synchronizes more. Two possibilities: 1) kernel fallback path causes syncs, 2) KV cache eviction timing interacts with batching and leads to memory thrash.

zara: I saw a similar smell last month but at smaller seqs — it was KV cache eviction cascading when multiple concurrent requests relied on prefix cache. Can you dump the runtime kv_cache counters while running the sweep?

maria: did a focused run forcing no kv-evict (KV_CACHE_ALLOW_EVICT=0) and also a run forcing a single kernel (RD_FORCE_KERNEL=flash_attention_v3). Results: forcing flash_attention_v3 removes the oscillation on H100 and throughput stabilizes ~+20% at batch6. Forcing fused_paged_v2 reproduces the jitter.

maria: ```
# forced kernel run (H100 seq=2048 batch=6)
env RD_FORCE_KERNEL=flash_attention_v3 ./run_bench.sh -> 11.9k stable
env RD_FORCE_KERNEL=fused_paged_v2 ./run_bench.sh -> 9.0k oscillating + p95 spikes
```

ali: good repro, thanks. Quick mitigation: increase selector hysteresis so we don't flip on small metric noise. Try RD_RUNTIME_KERNEL_HYSTERESIS=0.25 for canary. If that helps, it's a low-risk stopgap. Longer term we need to remove syncs from fallback or make fused_paged_v2 more conservative for H100 memory layout.

tom: can you run a micro where you enable CUPTI kernel timeline + runtime memstats for 60s at batch6/batch8? I want to see exact ordering of kernel launches + kv evict spikes.

maria: running now, will post traces in ~30m. also attaching a tiny flame snippet I captured (looks like occasional 20-30ms blackbox in kernel execution).

maria: ```
# flame excerpt (simplified)
0.0 - 0.5s: flash_attn_v3 kernels (8-9ms)
0.5 - 0.53s: fused_paged_v2 launch -> 27ms spike -> runtime_kv_eviction -> sync
0.53 - 1.0s: mixed kernels
```

deploy-bot: Canary config updated: RD_RUNTIME_KERNEL_HYSTERESIS=0.25 on h100-canary-pool. Monitoring p95 for 1h.

kevin: if hysteresis reduces flips, we can put a short-lived patch to default 0.2 for H100 until we fix fused_paged_v2 fallback path. I'll open a perf PR to add stricter shared-memory checks.

zara: created PERF-422 to track: "H100 fused_paged_v2 selector oscillation -> KV eviction + kernel syncs". Assigning to @kevin, @maria. Add traces and forced-kernel runs to the ticket.

maria: uploading full CUPTI & runtime logs to PERF-422 now. thanks everyone — will update once the canary runs finish. :thumbsup:

ali: follow-up note: replicate on L40S? L40S didn't show flips but showed slightly higher latency baseline; we'll keep an eye.

maria: last note — observed that the flips happen more when host CPU slightly overloaded (context switches). Might be minor, but could amplify selector oscillation. Recommend bounding selector decision to a moving-average of kernel_time rather than raw last-sample.

kevin: agreed. action items in PERF-422: 1) add moving-average window to selector 2) avoid sync-based fallback if possible 3) tighten fused_paged_v2 shared memory pre-check 4) monitor canary and roll if stable.

maria: thanks, closing thread for now — will ping when canary finishes with numbers. :sparkles:
